about: Decade rules for Back when (1.2 "The Dark Backward", companion/world/decades.py). A modern city in a world that runs in a past year takes on that year's decade: what pictures look like here, its prices from `prices`, and, in their own files, its era words (era_words.json `decades`), media (media/modern.json years), careers and hobbies (`years`) and politics (politics.json `years`). Nothing here applies in the present.

picture.scene: It is {year}: clothes, hair, phones, cars and shop fronts are from the {part} 1990s, nothing newer.

cameras.moment: Shot on a 35mm point-and-shoot film camera, warm colours, soft film grain, realistic skin texture.
cameras.selfie: Film snapshot look, slight wide-angle, warm colours, soft grain, realistic skin texture.
cameras.view: Film snapshot look, warm colours, soft grain, everything in the scene in focus.

framings.selfie: a fictional photo taken at arm's length with a disposable film camera, face and shoulders in frame, looking into the lens
framings.view: a fictional first-person film snapshot of what {subject} can see right now, nobody in focus

picture.scene: It is {year}: clothes, hair, phones, cars and shop fronts are from the {part} 2000s, nothing newer.

cameras.moment: Shot on a small digital point-and-shoot camera, on-camera flash, slightly cool colours, realistic skin texture.
cameras.selfie: Early digital camera look, slight wide-angle, on-camera flash, realistic skin texture.
cameras.view: Early digital camera look, slightly cool colours, everything in the scene in focus.

framings.selfie: a fictional selfie taken at arm's length with a small digital camera, face and shoulders in frame, looking into the lens
framings.view: a fictional first-person digital camera snapshot of what {subject} can see right now, nobody in focus

picture.scene: It is {year}: clothes, hair, phones, cars and shop fronts are from the {part} 2010s, nothing newer.

cameras.moment: Shot at eye level on a 2010s smartphone camera, slightly warm filtered colours, realistic skin texture.
cameras.selfie: Slight wide-angle 2010s smartphone front-camera look, warm filtered colours, realistic skin texture.
cameras.view: 2010s smartphone camera look, warm filtered colours, everything in the scene in focus.

picture.scene: It is {year}: clothes, hair, phones, cars and shop fronts are from the {part} 2020s, nothing newer.

prices.about: Rough yearly consumer price levels per currency (national consumer price indexes, rounded; the years between two listed ones are filled in at a steady rate). A city's rents and prices are written in today's money, so in a past year each is scaled by that year's level over the base year's. A currency not listed follows `fallback`. Euro amounts before 1999 stay in euros: a simplification for fiction.

since.about: Things from a later year, by the first year a past world can name them: the life admin, work projects and anything else drawn from a bank leave out what names one (decades.fits).
